name: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd.
summary: Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd. engages in the engineering, construction, and real estate businesses in Israel and internationally. The company constructs and develops office buildings, public buildings, and structures designed for the hi-tech industry; housing units, apartment buildings, and residential neighborhoods; and shopping centers and commercial buildings. It also engages in the construction and ownership of income real estate properties; and project development and implementation activities, including land investments, handling permits, construction, sales, and rental activities. In addition, the company undertakes infrastructure work, bridge construction, and building contracting activities. Meshulam Levinstein Contracting & Engineering Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.
